faq.q: What is Vice City in GTA 6?
faq.a: Vice City is the main city of Grand Theft Auto VI and the central urban location within the state of Leonida. It is Rockstar's contemporary reimagining of the setting first introduced in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002.

faq.q: Is Vice City in GTA 6 based on Miami?
faq.a: Yes. Vice City is modeled on Miami and South Florida, and Rockstar confirmed its neon-soaked, Miami-inspired identity in the first official trailer.

faq.q: When was Vice City confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar confirmed Vice City in the first official trailer on 5 December 2023, and it has anchored every piece of official marketing since, including Trailer 2 and the Netflix Extended Look.

faq.q: How does Vice City relate to Leonida?
faq.a: Vice City forms the core of the state of Leonida, acting as the central hub of GTA 6's map, according to the record's key facts.
